svg.title: Riju submits a timestamped upstream report while local rain remains below threshold.
svg.desc: The live circuit, clock mark, source, and release direction form a complete evidence bundle. Riju feeds it into the flood service as Cecil compares it with an empty local-rain branch.
svg.text: Page 41, panel 2 · Overhead close-up on the timestamped call record and external-report field

text.tspan: Riju submits the credible warning as external
evidence despite the absence of local rainfall.
